description: Modal dialog that builds a diagram from pasted CSV data. The user selects a target diagram type, maps CSV columns onto the required semantic fields through two-column label/select rows, and sees a sticky-header preview (first column pinned) plus the resulting node/edge stat chips before importing. Presents as a bottom sheet on narrow viewports.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: Auto follows the viewport (bottom sheet under 640px); a forced value never measures, so tests can render the sheet without a DOM.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTarget
parameters.description: Element focus returns to when the dialog closes — typically the diagram canvas.
